segments.name: BD Medical
products: IV medication safety and infusion therapy delivery systems
segments.description: Produces medical technologies and devices for hospitals, clinics, physicians' offices, consumers, pharmacies, and healthcare workers.
segments.evidence: BD Medical produces a broad array of medical technologies and devices that are used to help improve healthcare delivery in a wide range of settings.

segments.name: BD Life Sciences
products: Automated blood culturing and tuberculosis culturing systems
Microorganism identification and drug susceptibility systems
Antibodies and kits for performing cell analysis
segments.description: Provides diagnostic specimens collection, infectious disease detection, cancer diagnosis, and research tools for cellular study.
segments.evidence: BD Life Sciences provides products for the safe collection and transport of diagnostics specimens, and instruments and reagent systems to detect a broad range of infectious diseases, healthcare-associated infections and cancers.

segments.name: BD Interventional
products: Indwelling, intermittent and external urine catheters
BD ChloraPrep surgical infection prevention products
segments.description: Provides vascular, urology, oncology and surgical specialty products for single-use, temporary or permanent implantation.
segments.evidence: BD Interventional provides vascular, urology, oncology and surgical specialty products that are intended to be used once and then discarded or are either temporarily or permanently implanted.

revenueModel.text: Healthcare institutions, physicians, laboratories, pharmaceutical companies, and the general public pay for medical supplies, devices, laboratory equipment and diagnostic products.
revenueModel.evidence: BD is a global medical technology company engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of a broad range of medical supplies, devices, laboratory equipment and diagnostic products used by healthcare institutions, physicians, life science researchers, clinical laboratories, the pharmaceutical industry and the general public.

changes.text: In 2022, BD spun off its Diabetes Care business as Embecta Corp., a separate publicly-traded company.
changes.evidence: On April 1, 2022, BD completed the separation and distribution of Embecta Corp. ("Embecta"), formerly BD's Diabetes Care business, into a separate, publicly-traded company.

changes.text: In 2023, BD sold the Interventional segment's Surgical Instrumentation platform.
changes.evidence: In August 2023, BD completed the sale of the Interventional segment's Surgical Instrumentation platform pursuant to a definitive agreement that was signed in June 2023.
